g.title: MHB
g.text: 메트헤모글로빈혈증: 산화제는 촉매로 작동하고, 해독제는 전자 공급이 끊기면 독으로 바뀌며, 두 개의 측정값은 서로 반대 방향으로 틀린다
The poison is catalytic · the antidote and the poison are the same molecule · NADPH is the only currency · and neither number at the bedside is the disease

g.title: cluster_exposure
g.text: 1. 산화제 노출과 생체활성화 · Oxidant exposure and bioactivation

g.title: cluster_hb
g.text: 3. 헤모글로빈 산화환원 상태 · Haemoglobin redox state

g.title: cluster_cycle
g.text: 2. 공동산화 순환 — 산화제가 촉매가 되는 이유 · The co-oxidation cycle

g.title: cluster_b5
g.text: 4. NADH–사이토크롬 b5 환원효소 (생리적 경로, ~99%) · The physiological route

g.title: cluster_nadph
g.text: 5. NADPH — 하나의 한정된 전자 공급원, 세 개의 청구권 · ONE capped electron supply

g.title: cluster_gsh
g.text: 6. 글루타티온 · 활성산소 · 하인츠소체 · 용혈 · Glutathione, ROS, Heinz bodies, haemolysis

g.title: cluster_mbpd
g.text: 8. 메틸렌블루 산화환원 순환 — 갈림길 · The branch point

g.title: cluster_rescue
g.text: 9. 대체 · 구제 치료 — 서로 다른 항(term)을 공격한다 · Therapies attack DIFFERENT terms

g.title: cluster_allo
g.text: 10. 알로스테릭 효과 — 남아 있는 소단위에 무슨 일이 일어나는가 · Allostery

g.title: cluster_do2
g.text: 11. 산소 운반과 전신 보상 · Oxygen delivery and compensation

g.title: cluster_spo2
g.text: 12. 측정층 A — 맥박산소측정기 (환자 밖에 있다) · The pulse oximeter is not the patient

g.title: cluster_cooxy
g.text: 13. 측정층 B — 동시산소측정법과 포화도 격차 · Co-oximetry and the saturation gap

g.title: cluster_mao
g.text: 15. 해독제의 또 다른 약리작용 · The antidote's other pharmacology

g.title: cluster_host
g.text: 16. 유전 · 숙주 조절인자 · Genetic and host modifiers

g.title: cluster_clocks
g.text: 17. 두 개의 시계 — 반동(rebound)이 필연인 이유 · Two clocks

g.title: cluster_terms
g.text: 18. 세 개의 항 — 모든 치료는 이 셋 중 하나를 공격한다 · Three terms

g.title: EHC
g.text: (why dapsone t½ ≈ 30 h behaves like days)

g.text: iNO · nitrate-rich well water in infancy

g.text: one molecule oxidises HUNDREDS of haems

g.text: MODEL RESULT: NOT rate-limiting in vivo.
Peak is set by STOICHIOMETRY (nitrite is consumed),

g.text: KCN test — brown colour DISAPPEARS in MetHb

g.text: HbM: ferric haem STABILISED by the globin

g.text: ferric subunits LEFT-SHIFT the ferrous ones

g.text: ◆ 공급 한계 CAP = V_PPP × G6PD 활성

g.title: HBFALL
g.text: TOTAL Hb FALLS — and %MetHb FALLS WITH IT
because oxidised cells are cleared FIRST

g.text: Oxidised MB inside the red cell

g.text: 담즙 · 신 배설 (푸른 소변 · 푸른 대변)

g.text: (the model derives WHY it is cumulative)

g.title: CLOCK2
g.text: MB effect on blood is over in ~1 h

g.title: CEILING
g.text: Repeat dosing walks into the CUMULATIVE CEILING
— which is the argument for attacking CLOCK 1 instead

g.title: BR1
g.text: and it SHUTS OFF when the job is done

g.title: BR2->MBCUM
g.text: the harm is a TIME INTEGRAL

g.title: CIMET
g.text: → FORMATION term, and it KEEPS acting

g.title: TERMD
g.text: HBO · exchange transfusion · transfuse the anaemia

g.title: RIGHTSH
g.text: ◆ 만성 보상 = 정확히 반대 방향의 이동
CHRONIC COMPENSATION IS THE OPPOSITE MOVE
2,3-BPG right-shift CANCELS part of the met left-shift

g.title: PVO2
g.text: PvO₂ — THE state variable of the disease

g.title: NOTOX
g.text: and are simply wrong at Hb 8

g.title: RRATIO
g.text: the ONLY thing the device computes

g.text: (fitted in healthy volunteers who had NO dyshaemoglobin)

g.title: FLOOR85
g.text: R → 1 for ANY pigment absorbing equally at both λ,
and 110 − 25(1) = 85. A property of the DEVICE.

g.title: DEADZONE
g.text: the instrument stops responding where the patient is dying

g.title: CALCSAT
g.text: CALCULATED SaO₂ from PaO₂ — also normal,

g.title: REBOUND
g.text: REBOUND is a CONSEQUENCE, not a complication
(the model was never told it happens)

g.title: CHOICE
g.text: that, not the percentage, is the decision
